ya10.3.5:28.1: pañca puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānanti, no ca domanassindriyaṃ nappajahissanti. cattāro puggalā cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti, domanassindriyañca nappajahissanti.

ya10.3.5:30.1: aggamaggasamaṅgī domanassindriyaṃ nappajahissati no ca cakkhundriyaṃ na parijānāti. cattāro puggalā domanassindriyañca nappajahissanti. cakkhundriyañca na parijānanti.
